diff --git a/inflection/__init__.py b/inflection/__init__.py
index ffac5ce22e60816f18267d742455e4936b6d1c1a..81138b6367113c7a169dd078e0dbec3ac3a43f92 100644
--- a/inflection/__init__.py
+++ b/inflection/__init__.py
@@ -370,12 +370,38 @@ def titleize(word: str) -> str:
       'The Man Without A Past'
       >>> titleize("raiders_of_the_lost_ark")
       'Raiders Of The Lost Ark'
+      >>> titleize("NASA rocket launch")
+      'NASA Rocket Launch'
+      >>> titleize("read the HTTP spec")
+      'Read The HTTP Spec'
+
+    All-caps acronyms (two or more uppercase letters, optionally followed by
+    digits, as a whole word) are kept exactly as written.
 
     """
-    return re.sub(
+    # Shield acronyms from the lowercasing done by underscore()/humanize()
+    # using placeholders made only of control characters and digits, which
+    # those functions leave untouched.
+    acronyms: typing.List[str] = []
+
+    def _shield(match: typing.Match[str]) -> str:
+        acronyms.append(match.group(0))
+        return "\x00{}\x00".format(len(acronyms) - 1)
+
+    shielded = re.sub(
+        r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])[A-Z]{2,}[A-Z0-9]*(?![A-Za-z0-9])", _shield, word
+    )
+
+    titleized = re.sub(
         r"\b('?\w)",
         lambda match: match.group(1).capitalize(),
-        humanize(underscore(word)).title()
+        humanize(underscore(shielded)).title()
+    )
+
+    return re.sub(
+        r"\x00(\d+)\x00",
+        lambda match: acronyms[int(match.group(1))],
+        titleized
     )
